## Contrast contract

Worst WCAG 2.2 ratio over each declared pairing's surfaces (`styles/policy/contrast-contract.json`). `@rest` = bg0, bg1, bg1-highlight, bg1-bright, bg2, bg3, sidebar-bg, highlighted-bg; `@hover` = bg1-hover, bg2-hover, bg2-highlight, bg3-hover, sidebar-bg-hover, selected-bg.

Supplemental metadata and subtle boundary floors are owner-reviewed design decisions, below AA and WCAG 1.4.11 respectively. Passing those floors is not a WCAG conformance claim.

## Scales

### Type

| Utility | Size | Line height |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text-xxs` | 10px | inherited |
| `text-2xxs` | 11px | inherited |
| `text-3xxs` | 12px | inherited |
| `text-xs` | 13px | 18px |
| `text-dialog-title` | 15px | inherited |
| `text-sm` | 14px | 20px (Tailwind default) |

Weights: `font-normal` 400 · `font-medium` 450 · `font-semibold` 500 · `font-bold` 600.

### Radius

| Utility | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `rounded-sm` | 4px |
| `rounded-md` | 6px |
| `rounded-lg` | 8px |

### Spacing

Allowed Tailwind spacing steps (×4px): 0 · 0.5 · 1 · 1.5 · 2 · 2.5 · 3 · 3.5 · 4 · 5 · 6 · 7 · 8 · 10 · 12 — plus `px` (1px).

### Stacking layers

| Utility | z-index |
| --- | --- |
| `z-panel` | 30 |
| `z-chrome` | 40 |
| `z-dropdown` | 50 |
| `z-modal` | 50 |
| `z-toast` | 70 |
